summary:
• Gemini 4 Hydrogen — Google DeepMind's new large‑language model optimized for fast, cheap code generation and testing, offering a million‑token context and predictable pricing.
• ChatGPT Wallet — OpenAI's built‑in payment layer that lets AI agents complete purchases within the chat, removing checkout friction and preserving security checks.
• Claude Code — Anthropic's IDE‑integrated coding assistant, updated with security fixes and usability tweaks that improve reliability and clarity for pair‑programming.
• WebsiteBench — an open‑source benchmark that tasks AI agents with fully recreating live websites, providing functional and near‑perfect visual fidelity metrics.
• agentic‑hacking‑skills repository — a curated collection of AI‑driven security playbooks and skill templates enabling agents to perform scans, fuzzing, and reporting without manual prompting.
• AWS emulator — an official open‑source Rust‑based Docker project that locally mimics many Amazon services, allowing fast, cost‑free integration testing.
